content:
**S. Washington Street** is a roadway in Berkeley Springs, found in *Fallout 76*.

S. Washington Road runs south to north across Berkeley Springs. It starts at the Red Rocket, passes the Berkeley Springs Clinic to the right, and flanks the canal in the center of town to the left. It then passes Market Street twice on its right side, before intersecting with Fairfax Street near Amelia Espresso and the church. Past the intersection, it becomes N. Washington Street.

S. Washington Street appears in *Fallout 76*.
